target_pattern: Use trigger verb plus que plus present subjunctive when subjects differ, and use infinitive when subjects stay the same.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Translating want, hope, prefer, recommend, and insist without checking subject change.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Subjunctive appears after trigger verbs when the second verb has a different subject; same subject uses infinitive.
target_pattern_formula: same subject uses trigger plus infinitive
natural_examples: Prefiero que te quedes en casa.
Insisto en que me digas la verdad.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Quiero que estudies espanol. -> change subject in subordinate clause to nosotros.
Base: Espero que te mejores pronto. -> change verb to descansar.
Base: Deseo que tengas un buen dia. -> change recipient to plural ustedes.
Base: Prefiero que te quedes en casa. -> make it first-person plural in subordinate clause.
Base: Recomiendo que te acuestes temprano. -> change verb to comer.
Base: Insisto en que me digas la verdad. -> change object to todo.
Base: Quieres que limpie la mesa? -> change action to lavar los platos.
Base: Quieres que vaya a la tienda? -> change destination to el banco.
Base: Quieres que pague en efectivo? -> change method to con tarjeta.
Base: Quieres que te lleve a la oficina? -> change place to el aeropuerto.
Base: Quiero estudiar espanol. -> change to subject-change version with tu.
Base: Prefiero quedarme en casa. -> change to subject-change version with tu.
Base: Espero terminar hoy. -> change to subject-change version with nosotros.
Base: Insisten en hablar con el gerente. -> change to subject-change version with usted.
Base: Recomiendo que llames a tu madre. -> change subject to usted.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Indicative used after trigger with subject change.

common_errors.correct_spanish: Use either prefiero quedarme or prefiero que te quedes.
Use Quiero estudiar for same subject.
Use subjunctive conjugation such as vayas.

common_errors.mistake: Object pronouns omitted in nested clauses
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use forms like quieres que te lleve.

common_errors.mistake: Wrong person agreement in subordinate clause
common_errors.correct_spanish: Match person exactly, e.g. usted llame.
Use trigger plus que pattern with subject-change check.
